input.content:
Six weeks ago, three of us shipped Skycast 1.0 — a simple 7-day forecast app for iOS and Android. Here's what worked, and what we cut.

A two-week closed beta with 40 users surfaced 11 bugs; we fixed 9 before launch. That alone was worth the delay.

Two performance wins made the biggest difference:
- Crash rate dropped from 4% of sessions to 0.5% after we removed a background refresh that misbehaved on low memory.
- App start time went from 3.2s to 1.1s once we cached the last forecast on-device instead of waiting on the network.

The hardest call was cutting hourly radar maps from 1.0. They ate a third of our design time in month one, and only 2 of 40 beta users ever opened them. Ship less, ship sooner.

Six weeks in: 4.6 stars from 310 ratings. Top complaint? No home-screen widget. Guess what's next.

One habit we'll keep: a weekly 20-minute demo to the whole team. It caught two forecast-unit misunderstandings early — before they shipped.
